item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Agent 365 for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 in public preview. This lets security and IT teams view and govern SRE agents alongside other organizational agents, with each agent able to have its own Agent ID.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Entra authentication for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Microsoft Entra authentication is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you use identity-based database authentication and centrally manage access instead of relying on local credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Microsoft Entra authentication in public preview. Users can sign in with a Microsoft Entra account to authenticate to a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview : Microsoft entra kerberos authentication for Azure NetApp Files
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files now supports Microsoft Entra Kerberos authentication for SMB volumes in public preview. It allows hybrid and cloud-only users to authenticate via Microsoft Entra ID using cloud-issued Kerberos tickets.

  • Source: Azure Updates
